row.body: The motel room card grants a discount, but the checkout slip says the room was cleared before the guest’s key was returned.
row.title: The room discount

sidecar.gloss: A room is marked clear while its key remains out.
sidecar.rival_reading: A work crew could receive the same discount and leave early; the slip does not say who last occupied the room.

row.body: chalk numbers run across the wax crayons and bath towel. the count skips one place, then resumes in a different hand.
row.title: missing count beside the wax crayons

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
